node.statement: For X=U^dagger, involutivity gives X^dagger=U, so X^dagger bold-dot X=U bold-dot U^dagger has defect at most 25e by the preceding self-contained multiplier argument. Also X bold-dot U=U^dagger bold-dot U=J, so U is a right inverse of X. Thus X has a right inverse and ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<=25e, exactly the admissibility assertion required here, without using node 1.2.
